a: Gold/Silver/Bronze: $400, $300, $250 cash, plus up to $500 travel, free registration and up to six nights' lodging for finalists
dt: Advisor submits the nomination package to asedawards@avs.org by Oct 30, 2026 (same day as the ICMCTF 2027 abstract deadline)
e: Awards for graduate students in surface engineering, coatings and thin-film fields who are presenting authors of an oral talk at the ICMCTF 2027 conference. The student's advisor submits the application form, abstract, two-page research description, resume, evaluation form and recommendation letter; up to three finalists present at the conference.
unv: Conference dates and location are not stated on the awards page.
